title: Leukocyte composition entropy does not establish incremental elevated-CRP prediction across two NHANES samples
abstract: In 4,458 adults from the separately sampled NHANES 2001–2002 release, adding five-part leukocyte Shannon entropy to a 1999–2000-fitted WBC/NLR and demographic model changed weighted Brier error from 0.18325286 to 0.18326671. The gain was −0.00001385 (source-and-target PSU-bootstrap 95% interval −0.00126464 to 0.00070276); incremental predictive benefit was not established.
